summary: Harness environment and canonical Neo4j configuration handoff. Coding/Repair is authorized only to repair the Argo harness initializer and Neo4j projection/runtime configuration so `node .argo/scripts/ensureArgoHarnessEnvironment.js` loads only the approved repository-relative `.argo/.env` into `process.env` before projection/runtime checks, and projection configuration accepts only canonical `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_URL`, `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_USERNAME`, and `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD` while rejecting legacy `ARGO_NEO4J_URI`, `ARGO_NEO4J_USERNAME`, and `ARGO_NEO4J_PASSWORD` aliases before connection or write side effects. Full pre-coding baseline from `argo.runArchitectureTests`: 38 total, 36 passed, 2 failed, 0 missing acceptance criteria; failures are TS-01 (`TS01_HARNESS_ENV_FILE_LOADER_MISSING`) and TS-07 (`TS07_CANONICAL_NEO4J_ENV_NAMES_REQUIRED:EXTERNAL_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED`).

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the production Graph RAG semantic query, then inspect the Argo harness initializer behavior before Neo4j projection/runtime checks.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Node.js/Neo4j-native production evidence still holds, and the initializer loads only the repository-relative `.argo/.env` into process.env before projection, rejects root or alternate env files, preserves process precedence for credential-boundary conflict behavior, and emits no secret-bearing diagnostics.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Resolve missing credential scenarios, inspect credential source policy, and evaluate Neo4j projection configuration under canonical-only, legacy-only, and canonical-plus-legacy environment scenarios using synthetic values.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Canonical `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_URL`, `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_USERNAME`, and `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD` normalize into projection configuration; legacy `ARGO_NEO4J_URI`, `ARGO_NEO4J_USERNAME`, and `ARGO_NEO4J_PASSWORD` do not satisfy configuration and fail closed before driver/projection/index side effects; hardcoded defaults, fallback expressions, and Cypher credential transport remain absent.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Execute the existing live provider secret-isolation source matrix and controlled Neo4j authentication canary with synthetic canaries and approved source fixtures.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The source matrix includes a legacy-Neo4j-alias-only fixture that fails closed, canonical Neo4j database URL/username/password source attribution remains protected, `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD` reaches only database authentication, no secret leaks to observable channels, rejected fixtures have zero side effects, and cleanup leaves zero persistence.
